emily: tiny proposal: build a local 'replay-tester' proxy for onboarding sampleapps to simulate 429 storms, token rotation, and mid-stream drops so SDKs can exercise safe-replay paths.
kai: yes. minimal API: proxy forwards requests but can be scripted to return sequences like 200 (partial), 429, 200 or drop TCP. config via query params or small UI.
omar: opt-in header X-Redwood-Replay-Key to detect duplicate side effects. proxy keeps a short TTL store and emits a /report JSON.
emily: example curl for docs:
````
curl -X POST "http://localhost:8080/charge?mode=429-after-partial" -H "Authorization: Bearer LOCAL" -H "X-Redwood-Replay-Key: demo-abc" -d '{"amount":5}'
````
kai: SDK changes: node/python should offer auto-add replay key and hooks to override; go should define KeyProvider interface. default dev TTL 5m, docs recommend 24h for production idempotency keys.
omar: CI idea: nightly e2e matrix that runs sampleapp against proxy scenarios [token-rotate, mid-drop, 429-after-partial] and fails if duplicate side effects are detected.
ci-bot: scheduled: replay-tester/e2e will run nightly at 03:00 UTC. status posted to #devex.
emily: next: i'll spin a prototype (node proxy + /report). kai: drafting SDK surface. omar: CI job template. target: prototype before next onboarding session. :rocket:
